text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
at Win Variation's suggestion, we stopped by a seaside park.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—...Feels nice...
Just like before, that sea breeze...
choice_data_list: Oh, so you've been here before?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes, to tell you the truth—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Shion-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Cheval-san!
You came out to fish too?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
Right now, I put my rod over there and I'm taking a break...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Are you on your way back from an outing, Shion-san?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I was just passing by, so I figured I'd drop in.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Chevalier, this has
become a place I truly love.
(Tug, tug...)
choice_data_list: Huh? Isn't that getting all stringy?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You're right! It's totally working!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......!
This... might be a big one...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'll scoop it up with the net!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Please...!
I will... pull you up to the surface...!
(SPLAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—Caught you!!
—Yes...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm going to release this fish
in a safe spot, so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's fine.
I'll keep an eye on the fishing rod.

While Cheval Grand goes to release the fish,
I decide to ask Win Variation.
choice_data_list: Have you been here with Cheval before?
Have you been here with Cheval before?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes! Cheval-san brought me along.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
There was a time before when I was struggling a bit...
That was when Cheval-san invited me—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Catching any fish?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how it'll go today...
They might not take the bait so well...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......Is that so......
(Whooosh... whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...The ocean sure is vast.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why...
I felt like... you might accept someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, I-I'm sorry...
You probably have no idea... what I mean, right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......Nah, I totally get it.
It's kind of... comforting, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Back then, Chevalier-san didn't ask anything, and I didn't talk about my worries either, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It was just so cozy...
Before I knew it, my heart felt a lot lighter."
choice_data_list: Maybe that was her own way of showing she cared.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It was just so cozy...
Before I knew it, my heart felt a lot lighter."
choice_data_list: Maybe that was her own way of showing she cared.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I think so too, sir.
That still makes me happy even now...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...!
Making you watch over my fishing rod this whole time...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine.
...By the way, there's something I want to tell you again, Cheval-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for cheering me up
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad Cheval-san is my roommate...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Y-You're welcome...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
She's my precious roommate...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...You too, Miss Shion...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Watching Cheval made me want to try racing together again.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
There was a tackle shop with rental gear
near here, wasn't there?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like... would you like to use... this...?
It's my... spare fishing rod...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...!
I'm so grateful...!
